mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over 3 consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 6% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines for 2 consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS declines for 2 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS declines for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 consecutive months, coupled with a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), signals a strong demand environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases for 3 months and FEDFUNDS decreases
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST increases for 3 months and FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.
